downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.requirement: Needs link-level S2/S3 recall and S1 complete coverage
downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.streaming_solution: Compute running true link recall counts and S1 complete coverage per S1 entity during streaming

downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.requirement: Needs feature matrix X and binary labels y
downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.streaming_solution: Train LogisticRegression on a balanced/subsampled dataset (e.g. all positives + top hard negatives / random negative sample of 5M-10M pairs, <1GB RAM) or stream via SGDClassifier(loss='log_loss', partial_fit)

downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.requirement: Needs prediction probabilities per S1 entity to select top matches across thresholds (0.30 to 0.98)
downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.streaming_solution: Score validation candidates in S1 chunks, retain only candidates with P(match) >= min_threshold (e.g. 0.20) per S1 entity, aggregate S1-level precision/recall/F0.5 incrementally

downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.requirement: Needs top false positive and false negative candidate examples
downstream_operations_requiring_candidat.streaming_solution: Maintain bounded min-heaps (size 20) for top false positives and false negatives during streaming evaluation

recommended_architecture.feature_extraction: Chunk-by-chunk generator: yields (X_chunk, y_chunk, valid_pairs_chunk) for ~2.9M pairs per chunk (~290MB RAM peak)
recommended_architecture.entity_store: Lightweight LRU / chunk-scoped NormalizedEntity cache rather than loading full datasets
recommended_architecture.model_training: Stratified candidate negative subsampling for exact LogisticRegression (5M-10M pairs, fits in <1GB RAM) OR out-of-core SGDClassifier(loss='log_loss') with partial_fit()
recommended_architecture.validation_evaluation: Chunked streaming S1 inference maintaining only candidate links above threshold 0.20 per S1 entity
recommended_architecture.smoke_test_compatibility: Preserve exact logic; smoke test runs chunking in a single fast batch of 2,000 S1 entities
